2608.28974.title: From Analytics to Tumor Boards: An Evidence-Linked Multi-Agent Workflow for Oncology Feature Extraction
2608.28974.paper_summary: Clinically relevant oncology information is distributed across heterogeneous, longitudinal documentation, creating substantial abstraction burden and requiring accurate attribution across specimens, tumors, biomarkers, and time points, while manual cancer-registry abstraction can require 27.2 minutes per case, highlighting the need for scalable methods that preserve clinical context while converting documentation into structured data. We evaluate the Nimblemind Multi-Agent System (nMAS), a configurable oncology information-extraction workflow which extracts clinically relevant structured fields from fragmented oncology documentation. The extraction task uses a clinician-informed schema of 328 attributes spanning report metadata, diagnosis, staging, and cancer-type-specific information. nMAS separates clinician-defined field specifications from model execution and combines complexity-aware extraction, report-level consolidation, and source-grounded validation. The retrospective evaluation included 230 de-identified oncology documents from 40 patients and 418 clinician-reviewed document-field pairs containing 1,126 non-empty reference values. Evaluation focused on fields identified by clinicians as present in the source documents rather than exhaustively annotating all 328 schema fields. nMAS achieved a rank-weighted value-level precision of 82.6%, recall of 87.5%, and F1 of 85.0%, compared with an F1 of 66.4% for an independently implemented UMA-style MiniMax M2.5 comparator. These findings support the feasibility of using a configurable, source-grounded extraction workflow to convert fragmented oncology documentation into reusable structured data.
2608.28974.paper_summary_zh: 臨床相關的腫瘤學資訊分散在異質的、縱向的文檔中，這造成了相當大的抽象負擔，並要求在標本、腫瘤、生物標記和時間點之間進行準確的歸屬，而手動癌症登記的抽象每個案例可能需要27.2分鐘，突顯出需要可擴展的方法，這些方法在將文檔轉換為結構化數據的同時保持臨床背景。我們評估了Nimblemind多代理系統（nMAS），這是一個可配置的腫瘤學信息提取工作流程，能從零散的腫瘤學文檔中提取臨床相關的結構化字段。提取任務使用了一個由臨床醫生提供的328個屬性的架構，涵蓋報告元數據、診斷、分期和特定癌症類型的信息。nMAS將臨床醫生定義的字段規範與模型執行分開，並結合了複雜性感知的提取、報告級別的整合和基於來源的驗證。回顧性評估包括來自40名患者的230份去識別化的腫瘤學文檔和418對臨床醫生審核的文檔字段對，這些對中包含1,126個非空的參考值。評估集中於臨床醫生認為存在於源文檔中的字段，而不是對所有328個架構字段進行全面註釋。nMAS達到了82.6%的排名加權值級精度、87.5%的召回率和85.0%的F1值，而獨立實施的UMA風格MiniMax M2.5比較器的F1值為66.4%。這些發現支持使用可配置的、基於來源的提取工作流程將零散的腫瘤學文檔轉換為可重用的結構化數據的可行性。
